verdict.rationale: Snowflake's RBAC model lets admins create custom roles with narrowly scoped privileges and assign them to service/programmatic users, and the REST/SQL APIs plus MCP server support key-pair or token-based programmatic access that could be scoped to a limited role for an agent. But there is no dedicated agent-credential issuance flow, OAuth-scope UI, or documentation explicitly describing minting a scoped API key/token specifically for an AI agent; it relies on general-purpose RBAC repurposed for this use case. Missing for 10: dedicated agent-credential scoping/issuance workflow, explicit least-privilege API key generation docs for AI agents, hands-on confirmation of scoped-token issuance for an agent.
